notes.title: Small update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44945228/ba420b1329215d4298b9cbe8a06da797d024a558.jpg


- More mission points from all missions and main quest.

- Fewer and simplier missions on 1st planet. This planet should be only a tutorial-like episode before greater journey. I want players to spend less time there.

- Fixed a few typos and other small bugs.

notes.title: Small update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44945228/37152400f9d330206fe844262a5b706e041b8f6d.jpg

- A few small fixes in conversations.

- Added a few new plants on tropical planets. Some of them were too often repeated.

-  Added geological oddities and other rare things to scan on some moons. They will be found rather in uninhabited systems.

notes.title: Fix & update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44945228/e45b1cf0538224278bcdea81c83e204e5812acf7.jpg

- New spaceship explosions! Nicer animation= bigger satisfaction from victory.

- Fixed bug in spaceship shield recharge. For longer time i knew there was something wrong, but i could not find the error. Due to a bug the player ship was totaly immune to enemy attacks during shield recharge, while logicaly this should be the time window for enemies to put some damage in it. Space combat might get a little harder after i fixed this bug, but fear not. I bear gifts to sweeten this pain. There are new bonuses in 2 skills.

- Survival skill will also increase amount of damage repaired with Hull Repair System.

- Gadgeting skill increases Stealth Generator, Hoverboard time plus, from now on, also Personal Shield time and it will decrease Spaceship Shield recharge time.

- New animation for Aratrax 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44945228/68e7e1003c279af8dd168966c5243b0b871bffd7.jpg

- New animation for Scortin
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44945228/acef19731283a178f742ff06524b9cdf521b22e8.jpg

- New animation for Celefar. Looks kinda funny, like some alien dinosaur/unicorn. And now it even has magical horn attack. You'll see :]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44945228/d4739d58f5f99b16fac3d36cf3248d9924756170.jpg

- A few more enemy ships gained speed boost.

- Player's ship weapon Photon Cannon will now fire the bullets a little faster.

- Snow should no longer generate during esc menu pause.

- Fixed bug with equipping hoverboard V5.

notes.title: Small update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44945228/f0a05b6d0b07194d66aef1b42d728a7220d49667.jpg


- Added better camera movement in spaceship mode. Now the camera keeps up with the speed of the ship, even in speed boost mode, to always show the area in front of the ship. Previously, at higher speeds, the ship would fly almost at the edge of the screen, slamming straight into asteroids ¯⁠\⁠⁠(⁠ツ⁠)⁠⁠/⁠¯

- Fixed small graphical bugs in the interior of spaceship number 4

notes.title: Small update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44945228/bcdb4c2e46255bd9eb526236b00d82f25244d64d.png

- Hand weapons rebalance. The dmg of slow-firing weapons has been modified to make them more useful compared to faster weapons, such as gatling lasers. Slow weapons, like the Heavy Laser, are now almost as powerful and at the same time more economical because they use less ammunition. Plasma weapons are now even more distinctive from lasers, as they have a noticeably higher minimum dmg.

- There was albo a little bug with landing on planets during space combat. It was possible to accidentally press the landing button while holding left mouse button and shooting at enemy ships. This caused the player's ship to be paralyzed for 10 seconds for the duration of the landing. During this time, enemies continued to attack until the player landed. This is now fixed. To land, you have to stop shooting and then click the button.

notes.title: Getting ready for release
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44945228/59f61fa30bbfb5dea44c9e345039c050ec613973.jpg

Testing is completed. I was surprised how many bug i found. Some ware in the missions/miniquests system, some in weapon names, releasing prisoners, planet names.  And 3 bugs ware in the main quest, blocking a possibility to finish the game.
All bugs i found are now fixed.
There is still a couple of days to the release. I might yet find something.
But generally i think Hyperspacer is getting ready to go into hyperspace.
